label: Midterm 1

coverage.text: Fall 2026 Midterm 1 (Mon 9/14, 8–9pm, 20 points, paper) covered lectures 1–6 and textbook sections 1.1–1.6, not including the Newton’s Method example.

scope.note: Problems are included when every topic the course staff tagged them with is on Midterm 1. That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation.

noPicks: Course staff haven’t published Midterm 1 question picks, so nothing is marked recommended. The Fall 2026 Midterm 1 itself is the closest practice.

timed.intro: Each exam draws original past Midterm 1 problems from this study option at random, mixing environment diagrams, what-would-Python-display, control, and higher-order functions like the real exam. They aren’t modified, so you may have seen some of them already.
